notes.note: Another injury for Daniels with a calf this week which will see him spend time on the sidelines yet again. A cruel blow for him and the coaches that have brought him in on the back of some great form in recent weeks.

Daniels was the talk of the Supercoach world this week with his low price and low BE. He delivered us a goal and 18 disposals but did give away 3 free kicks. He will be a good one to have that you can swing between mid and forward to cover donuts on the run home.
Daniels got off to a quick start in the game but did slow down ending with a couple of goals from his 13 disposals.
This makes two games for Daniels now and both have been good with a great game this week. However we know he has a poor injury history so just beware if you take the risk.
Daniels returned to the side this week with 3 goals from his 14 disposals which is a solid result for him.
